recipes.name: Chicken and Chourico Pizza
ingredients_raw: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into small chunks
1 (13.4 ounce) package room-temperature fresh pizza dough
salt and ground black pepper to taste
0.5 link Portuguese hot chourico sausage - halved lengthwise and sliced into thin half moons
1 (8 ounce) package shredded mozzarella & cheddar pizza cheese

steps.text: Preheat an oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C). Prepare a pizza pan with olive oil and flour.
Heat 2 teaspoons olive oil in a skillet over medium heat; cook the chicken in the hot oil until no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, 5 to 10 minutes. Set aside.
Dust a flat working surface with flour. Roll the pizza dough out to the size of your pizza pan. Place dough on the prepared pan.

Stir the tomato sauce, 1 tablespoon olive oil, garlic, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper together in a small bowl; spread evenly over the surface of the dough. Scatter, in order, the chicken, chourico, red onion, banana peppers, pizza cheese, and Parmesan over the tomato sauce mixture.
Bake in the preheated oven on the middle rack until the cheese is lightly browned, about 20 minutes. Switch the oven setting to broil and cook another 5 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Chicken and Chourico Pizza
raw_recipe.description: This recipe for a pizza topped with Portuguese hot chourico sausage, chicken, red onion, and banana peppers uses a pre-made pizza dough.

review.reviewBody: Hey Raquel. It is a great recipe, and I wanted the opportunity to explain myself. I just realized you saw the website, and haven't heard what I do on the radio. You know my email, so feel free to email me as soon as possible to we can rectify this situation. Scott
Used tofu instead of chicken and italian sausage, hate me for doing it but I only write cause it my help a vegetarian reading out there :-). Anyway, the pizza was delicious!
Great pizza, our only change was to use canned chicken to save time. We will definitely make this again!

This was delicious! I used my own whole wheat crust and omitted the banana peppers because I had none - added a little chopped red bell pepper and a few mushrooms I needed to use up. The addition of chicken makes this a very hearty, meaty pizza, and I love that unmistakeable chourico flavor and the garlicky sauce. Thanks, Raquel!
